notes.title: 🖤 Thank you for your reviews. They mean more than you think. 🖤
notes.notes:
[p][b]Lucky Bastard[/b] isn’t a game made to please everyone. [/p][p]It’s not a polished product crafted to follow trends or fit the mainstream.[/p][p]It’s a raw, honest, adult story. Where choices have consequences, the protagonist is full of flaws, and morality has its own face.[/p][p]I made this game alone. No trends. No producers behind my back. Just the desire to tell this exact story — and reach those who truly feel it.[/p][p]If you’ve already left a review — [b]thank you[/b].
You’re helping this game survive in a world where algorithms choke anything original.[/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FUDoAcQ.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t yet — I’d be grateful if you took a minute to share your thoughts.[/p][p][b]Every “Recommended” isn’t just a word. It’s support for someone who chose to walk his own path.[/b][/p][p]Thank you for staying with me.[/p][p]— Dev[/p]

notes.title: 🖤 Thank you, bastards. You made this possible. 🖤
notes.notes: [h3][b]Lucky Bastard[/b] has been released. [/h3][p]It's been a long road, considering that this is my first project.[/p][p]No producers, no team, no marketers. I did it alone, using my experience and my vision of what an adult visual novel should be.[/p][h3][b]But none of it would have meant anything without you.[/b][/h3][p]You played, supported, criticized, praised, shared your impressions, and helped us move forward.[/p][p]If you enjoyed [b]Lucky Bastard[/b], [b]please leave a positive review on Steam.[/b][/p][p]For a solo developer, it's not just “nice” — it literally saves the game from oblivion.[/p][p]Every review helps the project avoid getting lost in the algorithms and gives it a chance to continue.[/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FvQt17S.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This isn't the end. There will be a sequel to the story of Lisa and Olga. There will also be a separate story about Margo.[/p][p]🎭 And if you want to discuss scenes, girls, or just vent, check out the discussions and our Discord.[/p][p][b]Thank you for being with me.[/b][/p][p]Stay lucky, –  dev[/p]

notes.title: 💬 Your Review Makes a Difference
notes.notes: [h3]Hi to all players of Lucky Bastard[/h3][p][/p][p]I'm the solo developer behind this game, and I’m reaching out directly to ask for your support.[/p][p]If you enjoyed the story, characters, atmosphere, or the scenes — please consider leaving a positive [/p][p]review on the store page. It takes less than a minute, and it truly helps.[/p][p][/p][h3]💬 Why does it matter?[/h3][p]Steam heavily relies on user reviews to decide which games to show to others.[/p][p]Right now, the game is sitting at around 75%, and every positive review really makes a difference in [/p][p]getting the game seen.[/p][p][u]Your words[/u] — even just a simple “I liked it” — can change the visibility of this project for other potential [/p][p]players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FY4WwJt.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]❤️ Reviews are not just numbers[/h3][p]For me, as a solo indie developer, reviews are the lifeline. This isn’t a corporate project — it’s personal, [/p][p]built with passion, experience, and honesty.[/p][p][/p][p]If Lucky Bastard meant something to you, please leave a trace. It helps more than you know.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Thank you for your time. And your review.[/u][/p][p]Stay lucky, –  dev[/p]

notes.title: News about the final version
notes.notes: [p]I previously announced that I plan to release the final version of the game at the end of June, but Steam's Summer Sale is starting soon. Steam does not recommend switching from early access to the final version during the sale. Therefore, I would like to inform everyone that the final version will be released after the Summer Sale ends. Lucky Bastard will still be available in the Summer Sale with the “Early Access” label. [/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/Fuh3jpI.jpg"][/img]In the meantime, enjoy your favorite coffee at Kelly's[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]#SteamSummerSale #VN #NSFW[/p]

notes.title: Early access release. What's next?
notes.notes:
Lucky bastard was released on the 24th. During this time was collected a certain amount of feedback, which was studied . And in connection with this, I would like to tell you about the upcoming changes:

• Achievements will be added.
• Corrections in the translation of the text.
• The game's walkthrough map will be published so you can explore all the content.

If you notice any bugs in the game please report them in the game center Lucky bastard to solve the problem.

Clerik studio are working hard to bring you new and improved features. Follow our updates to stay up to date with the latest changes and improvements!

P.S. If you are still planning to buy the game, you better hurry up, because the 30% discount associated with the release of the game will soon end.
